name: branding-kids-supplement-packaging-photo-series
title: Playful supplement packaging photographed on saturated colour backgrounds
whatItIs: A vertical stack of product photos: tubs and gummies on emerald green, star- and sun-shaped gummies scattered on blue and white, vegetables beside a tub on mustard, and split-colour shots of tubs pouring gummies. The tubs have wavy blue, mint and orange bands and illustrated planets.
whatItMeans: Bright, fun and wholesome; strong flat backgrounds and shaped gummies make the packaging pop.
techniques: Place products on single flat colours drawn from the packaging.
Scatter the product itself (shaped gummies) as pattern.
Pair products with whole foods to signal real ingredients.
Split a frame in two colours for graphic contrast.

vocabulary.definition: A photo background of one flat saturated colour.
A flowing curved stripe on packaging.
An image divided into two colour halves.
